quotes.text: Nothing is difficult; the only fear is a wavering heart. Dig mountains, fill seas — with resolve, it will be done.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh

quotes.text: Towards yourself: be diligent, thrifty, honest and upright.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh
quotes.source: Six teachings to the People's Public Security (1948)

quotes.text: Towards colleagues: be caring and helpful.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh
quotes.source: Six teachings to the People's Public Security (1948)

quotes.text: Towards the Government: be absolutely loyal.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh
quotes.source: Six teachings to the People's Public Security (1948)

quotes.text: Towards the people: be respectful and courteous.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh
quotes.source: Six teachings to the People's Public Security (1948)

quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh
quotes.source: Six teachings to the People's Public Security (1948)

quotes.text: Towards the enemy: be resolute and shrewd.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh
quotes.source: Six teachings to the People's Public Security (1948)

quotes.text: Whatever benefits the people, we must do with all our strength. Whatever harms the people, we must avoid with all our strength.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh

quotes.text: Unity, unity, great unity. Success, success, great success.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh

quotes.text: For ten years' benefit, plant trees; for a hundred years' benefit, cultivate people.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh

quotes.text: Nothing is more precious than independence and freedom.
quotes.author: President Ho Chi Minh

quotes.text: Forget oneself for the country, serve the people.
quotes.author: Vietnam People's Public Security

quotes.text: The essence of humanity and righteousness is to keep the people at peace.
quotes.author: Nguyen Trai
quotes.source: Great Proclamation upon the Pacification of the Wu (1428)

quotes.text: Lightning speed, still faster; boldness, still bolder; make use of every hour, every minute.
quotes.author: General Vo Nguyen Giap

quotes.text: Our country has never had the foundation, potential, position and international prestige it has today.
quotes.author: General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong

quotes.text: Bring the country into a new era — the era of the Vietnamese nation's rise.
quotes.author: General Secretary To Lam

device.description: Tracked vehicles and the officers assigned to them
device.imeiTip: Device identifier, unique within a unit

user.description: Web accounts (dispatchers, commanders) and App accounts (officers on vehicles)

user.noWebAccessHint: Missing “Access admin site” — mobile app only

user.roleNoWebHint: This role lacks “Access admin site”: the account cannot sign in to the web until that permission is granted under Permissions.
user.roleHint: The gps_user role is for officers' App accounts.

role.description: Permission bundles per role; an account's permissions = role bundle + direct grants
role.noWebAccessWarn: This role lacks “Access admin site”: its holders cannot sign in to the web unless granted that permission individually.

desc.tenant_admin: Read and write the whole branch; manage accounts, roles, vehicles and incidents.
desc.unit_admin: Read the whole branch, write within own unit, edit own unit info.
desc.gps_user: App account: only sees incidents its vehicle is assigned to.
desc.customer_user: Can enter the admin site; other permissions granted directly.
desc.custom: Empty role — permissions are granted directly.

permission.fromRole: Comes from the role, cannot be removed individually
permission.notGrantable: You do not hold this permission, so you cannot grant it
